summary: In Thousand Needles, Quentin waits as the sprite darter egg nears hatching. The Moonweavers gave you the egg, and Quentin asks for two elixirs of fortitude so he can check its health and protect it.

sections.title: Protecting the Egg
sections.body:
Quentin finds it intriguing that the Moonweavers cared for the egg, and he considers them both capable. Since they gave the egg to you, you may take responsibility for it as long as you wish. It looks almost ready to hatch, but Quentin wants to check its health and make sure it is undamaged first.

A small spell will protect the egg. Quentin has every component except two elixirs of fortitude. While he waits, he admits he is growing tempted by the races. Once he knows the egg is healthy, he will return it for you to keep.

faq.q: Who is asking for the elixirs?
faq.answer: Quentin waits in Thousand Needles by the Mirage Raceway and asks for two elixirs of fortitude.

aliases: where did the egg come from
faq.answer: You brought the egg to Quentin in An Orphan Looking For a Home. The Moonweavers gave it to you.

faq.q: What is needed to finish the spell?
aliases: what do i need to bring
faq.answer: Quentin needs two elixirs of fortitude for the spell. He already has the other components.

faq.q: Why does Quentin want the elixirs?
faq.answer: The egg is almost ready to hatch, and Quentin wants to make sure it is healthy and undamaged. The elixirs are part of a small spell to protect it.

angles.text: As an alchemist, you can brew the elixirs of fortitude Quentin asks for.
